name: Lophophine
summary: Lophophine, also known as 2C-MMDA-1, 5-methoxy-MDPEA, or 3-methoxy-4,5-methylenedioxyphenethylamine (MMDPEA or MMDPEA-1), is a psychedelic drug of the methylenedioxyphenethylamine family. It is the α-demethylated homologue of MMDA, and is also closely related to mescaline (3,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine) and MDPEA. Lophophine has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

summaryZh: 3-甲氧基-4,5-亞甲二氧基苯乙胺，簡稱MMDPEA是取代亞甲二氧基苯乙胺類的迷幻藥和放心藥藥物。它是MMDA的α-脫甲基化類似物，也和麥司卡林緊密相關。
